mobbin:7b9d5db3-24d8-49ae-827e-218db2b44.summary: sees a vehicle home dominated by battery percent and uses Lock or Unlock or Climate and Energy shortcuts. They scroll a two-by-two status-widget grid, then open a vehicle menu where Updates is the highlighted action item.
steps: Home with battery percent dominant and Lock or Unlock
Home scrolled to Climate and Energy tiles
Widget grid for Climate, Energy, Gear Guard, and Location
Vehicle menu with Drivers and keys and secondary links
steal: One status dominates as a large battery percent, as a single primary glance metric rather than a headline-number strip.
A single main action pair is Lock or Unlock under the asset, and secondary module tiles (Climate, Energy) sit below.
Each widget shows a status line plus a one-tap circular action for fan, charge, camera, or map.
The Updates card uses colour to show a pending action above otherwise muted menu rows.
avoid: An equal-weight colourful two-by-two widget grid can become clutter if every module tile fights for attention, which conflicts with show little, but precisely.
mobbin:7b9d5db3-24d8-49ae-827e-218db2b44.fit: Dashboard: dominant health percent plus one main action is the system-health and center-overview pattern (All systems OK versus N rooms failing). Lock or Unlock maps to start or stop Recording for a room. Updates is the action-items cue.
